ns2:section.sectionText: This course is a special exploration course intended to engage women undergraduates majoring in mathematics, science, and engineering curricula in museum work in the Champaign-Urbana area. Class meetings will take place at the WIMSE living/learning community, a local museum, as well as online. This course is restricted to students living in the WIMSE (Women in Mathematics, Science, and Engineering) living/learning community. Class will meet in the Florida Avenue Residence Hall, Room 5. Instructor permission required to enroll: Donna Michelle Hinn (hinn@uiuc.edu); Bertram (Chip) Bruce (chip@uiuc.edu).
